posts.body_html:
If I remember right, this cultivar was registred in the first ever issue of the CPN that I got. Because this, “Alucard”, “Royal Ruby”, and “Black Widow” were the sarrs registered in that issue, I thought that it was normal to have such nice new cultivars in every issue. It took me a while to figure out that that wasn’t the case.

Anyway, the photos look really nice. This is a really nice plant.

It's really weird, but some people can detect certain scents, while others can't. I have "20/20 smell" if that's a thing, but there's a bulb from South Africa (Babiana sp.) that I cannot smell, yet the curator of the UCD botanical gardens can smell it loud and clear! Weird.

I think the same thing might be happening with reptilian rose-perhaps not everyone can detect that particular aroma. I wouldn't say the rose smell on Reptilian Rose is as strong as a highly perfumed rose (LOL) but I can consistently detect the smell, even in cold weather.
